name: Dragon Grove
summary:
Dragon Grove is a free and relaxing 3D puzzle game where you can match, merge, and grow your garden with magical dragons! Strategy, skill and dragons await- Ferntastic!

The dragons need your help!  Solve imaginative puzzles, unlock powerful dragon abilities, and earn rewards for your dragons within your own living room. 

So grab a cup of tea, get cozy in your favorite chair, and enjoy tending to your grove with your dragon to find out where magic takes root.  




# Dragons in your Hand 🐉
